岗位职责 (Job Responsibilities)
1、产品公关策略与推进
深度跟进公司机器人、具身智能基础模型的研发与商业化落地周期,制定从产品预热到首发上市的端到端(End-to-End)产品公关策略。
协同产品、研发团队,提炼新一代软硬件产品(特别是基于WUM 模型的新特性)的差异化卖点,制定符合业务目标的整合传播方案与 SOP。
2、技术理解与场景化叙事构建
担任“技术翻译官”角色。深入理解端到端大模型、世界模型、Zero-shot(零样本泛化)等底层技术逻辑,并将其转化为 To B 客户(如家政、物流合作伙伴)和 To C 大众更容易感知的商业价值与应用场景。
挖掘机器人在真实物理世界复杂场景中的长尾(Long-tail)优秀表现,包装打造具有代表性的产品应用案例(Use Cases)。
3、科技评测体系与口碑管理
建立并主导具身智能产品的外部评测标准。引导行业及媒体从传统的“动作演示评估”逐步转向“真实环境泛化成功率”等更核心的指标。
独立策划并执行针对硬核科技媒体、数码及前沿科技 KOC/KOL 的定向体验与评测沟通会。
负责日常产品口碑的舆情监测,建立核心媒体与意见领袖的“布道者”阵营。
4、高质量产品物料与内容生产
主导关键产品公关内容的输出,包括但不限于:重磅产品新闻稿、深度技术解析长文及公开发布会的高管演讲内容。
严控所有对外输出的产品素材质量,坚持“真实泛化”的底线,避免任何可能引发误解的技术演示包装。
5、产品级危机预防与沟通
针对具身智能产品在真实入户或商业环境中可能遇到的物理碰撞、操作失误、隐私合规等敏感边界问题,前置制定产品公关危机预案及 Q&A 口径。
协同售后与技术团队,快速响应并妥善处理突发的产品负面舆情。
fields.requirements:
任职资格 (Qualifications)
1、经验背景
拥有 5 年以上智能硬件、手机、汽车、机器人、AI 算法公司或复杂消费电子产品公关/产品营销经验。
有过从 0 到 1 参与重量级科技产品发布会、深度参与过软硬件结合产品 GTM 流程者优先。
2、媒介与行业资源
具备较为丰富的硬核科技媒体、头部数码评测机构及 KOL 资源。
熟悉 B 站、知乎、微信公众号等核心内容平台的科技圈层传播玩法。
3、专业核心技能
较强的“硬核”理解力: 能够顺畅地与算法工程师、硬件产品经理对话,快速消化复杂的 AI 技术文档与前沿论文概念。
卓越的文字功底: 既能撰写逻辑严密的深度技术公关稿,也能写出具有感染力和场景感的产品故事。
项目管理能力: 具备良好的多线任务并行能力与 WBS(工作分解结构)执行力,能在高压和快速迭代的节奏中推进跨部门协作。PMP 认证通过者优先。
有记者经历、KOL、自媒体经验者优先。
4、软性素质要求
985 本科及以上学历
务实求真: 拒绝“为了 PR 而 PR”的浮夸作风,坚持用真实的技术数据和落地事实说话。
抗压与拥抱变化: 在充满不确定性的前沿科技赛道,能够快速适应战略调整与产品迭代节奏。
对具身智能和通用人工智能(AGI)抱有较强的热情与好奇心。

核心职责:
一、战略研究与决策支撑
1)围绕具身智能核心方向,开展问题导向型研究,为专项推进提供决策依据。
2)快速完成商业模式设计、合作模式创新与风险评估等工作,输出可直接指导行动的分析结论。
3)将碎片化信息结构化,形成公司层面的知识沉淀与决策备忘录,支撑管理层在资源分配、合作选择、节奏把控上的关键判断。

二、战略专项推进与项目BP
1)担任公司级重点战略专项的核心推进BP,负责专项的整体推进、关键节点把控与风险预警。
2)作为跨部门协作枢纽,主动连接研发、产品、市场等团队,拆解战略目标为可执行的项目计划,推动各方对齐优先级、落实资源投入。
3)深入链接外部资源,为重点项目导入产业链资源。

三、对外合作
1)参与重点商业项目的全流程推进,包括前期论证、方案设计、商业谈判、项目推进与落地跟踪。
2)参与具身产业链项目的全流程合作推进,包括项目sourcing、技术判断、项目研究、投资分析等。
3)协助建立和维护关键合作伙伴关系,为公司长期战略布局积累可持续的生态资源。
fields.requirements:
任职要求:
一、硬性技能与经验
1)国内外知名高校学历,2年以上工作经验。
2)具备咨询公司、投资机构、科技公司战略部/战投部等相关经验。
3)具备扎实的逻辑分析与结构化思维能力,能快速理解复杂业务问题,独立搭建分析框架,做出合理判断。
4)具备优秀的分析、报告撰写与呈现能力,能将复杂问题清晰、简洁地表达给不同背景的听众。

二、软性素质与思维
1)强推动力与结果导向:不满足于“分析完毕”,而是执着于“落地见效”;能在模糊与变化中主动推进,对结果负责。
2)卓越的协同与影响力:善于与研发、产品、销售、职能等不同背景团队沟通,能用对方听得懂的语言解释战略,赢得信任与配合。
3)高度的责任心与抗压能力:能适应创业型公司的快节奏与多任务并行,在关键项目中敢于担当、主动补位。
4)深度思考与快速学习:对具身智能、机器人、AI等领域有强烈好奇心,能快速理解新技术、新场景背后的商业逻辑。

三、优先条件
1)有机器人、人工智能、高端制造、互联网等相关领域经验,或参与过新业务孵化、产业合作落地、供应链/制造项目者优先。
2)对具身智能产业有认知。
3)有“从0到1”推动项目落地的完整经历,并能清晰复盘项目中的关键决策与经验教训。

Cross-Functional Collaboration:
Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to become a subject matter expert on Agility’s hardware and software applications. Collaborate tightly with a world class creative team to bring product storytelling to life across all marketing channels.

Use data-driven insights and market trends to establish clear priorities for demand generation, ensuring campaigns align with current product capabilities and priority industries.

As a Product Marketing Manager for Atlas, you will be an integral part of our world-class product team that is shaping the story around next-generation applications for humanoid robotics technology. Atlas is the world’s most recognizable humanoid and is on the journey from research to real-world use. You will be a key part of crafting that story - demonstrating how Atlas and Boston Dynamics are ready to solve the most complex automation challenges for the world’s largest manufacturers.
As we ramp up with our early adopter customers and set the stage to expand, you will be key in continuing our efforts to scale awareness. To thrive in this role, you must be enthusiastic about new technology, technology that is changing the way people work, and be ready to lead strategic initiatives that put Atlas and our AI advances top of mind.
Boston Dynamics is the global leader in mobile robotics, consistently tackling the toughest challenges in the field. While our
viral videos on YouTube
have long captured the world’s imagination by showing what robots
can
do, we are now focused on what they
must
do. We are rapidly transforming our research powerhouse into a go-to-market powerhouse that is powered by our research expertise. We are a recognized leader in industrial automation, delivering robust solutions that drive ROI in the world’s most demanding warehouse and logistics environments.
A writing sample and a product launch sample are preferred when submitting your application.
How you will make an impact:
Own the strategy and execution of Atlas announcements, developing go-to-market plans, and partnering  with stakeholders across product management, engineering, sales, and more.
Become the subject matter expert on Atlas hardware and applications and understand positioning its capabilities to the needs of our customers and market.
Shape the storytelling around the  journey of Atlas from the development phase into the real world, highlighting our advanced AI and software development.
Create messaging and product positioning for Atlas for target personas
Plan and develop content to support each stage of the buyer’s journey, including sales collateral and presentations, videos, case studies, webinars, blogs, whitepapers, and more.

Minimum 8 years of experience in marketing or product management
Demonstrated ability to execute high-level launches and campaigns
Great storyteller and writer who can turn industry and product complexity into clear and engaging positioning and narrative
Highly organized and self-directed individual

Sr. Manager, Customer Success
 
About Dexterity
At Dexterity, we believe robots can positively transform the world. Our breakthrough technology frees people to do the creative, inspiring, problem-solving jobs that humans do best by enabling robots to handle repetitive and physically difficult work.
 
We’re starting with warehouse automation, where the need for smarter, more resilient supply chains impacts millions of lives and businesses around the world. Dexterity's full-stack robotics systems pick, move, pack, and collaborate with human-like skill, awareness, and learning capabilities. Our systems are software-driven, hardware-agnostic, and have already picked over 15 million goods in production. And did we mention we’re customer-obsessed? Every decision, large and small, is driven by one question – how can we empower our customers with robots to do more than they thought was possible?
Dexterity is one of the fastest growing companies in robotics, backed by world-class investors such as Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, and Obvious Ventures. We’re a diverse and multidisciplinary team with a culture built on passion, trust, and dedication. Come join Dexterity and help make intelligent robots a reality!
 
About the Role
The Sr. Manager, Customer Success role at Dexterity is a critical position responsible for ensuring customer satisfaction and retention. This individual will manage and execute activities within assigned customers throughout their contract lifecycle, including onboarding, training, and ongoing support. With a focus on program management, Sr. Manager, Customer Success will support the customer relationship during the entire robotics customer deployment lifecycle. The successful candidate will have a proven track record of managing multiple customers and being resilient and adaptable while navigating ambiguous customer tasks. In addition, they should be able to build strategic working relationships with customers and collaborate across multiple departments to influence all levels within an organization.
 
The Sr. Manager, Customer Success will also be responsible for analyzing KPI trends and suggesting process improvement recommendations to ensure customer satisfaction and retention. This requires the ability to conduct up-front analysis of the customer experience, identify gaps, and create future-state plans. This position requires strong organizational, communication, and relationship-building skills, as well as a deep understanding of Dexterity's robotics technology and how it can be applied to meet customer needs. Ultimately, the Sr. Manager, Customer Success will play a critical role in ensuring Dexterity's customers are successful in their use of robotics, helping to transform the world through breakthrough technology.

Marketing Principal/ Director - Physical AI 
Location: Redwood City, California (Bay Area)
Employment type: Full-time, Regular
Role Scope: Overall Marketing Lead
Reports to: VP, Product & Enterprise Growth
About Dexterity
Dexterity is the enterprise Physical AI company building intelligent robots for complex industrial work. 
 
Dexterity's Mech systems combine Foresight world model, robotics, and Physical AI platform to perform demanding logistics workflows, including trailer loading, trailer unloading, airport baggage handling, etc. at the speed, reliability, and safety levels required for high-volume operations. Dexterity's Foresight World Model powers real-time perception, planning, and execution across physical environments with the interpretability required for industrial deployment. Dexterity is headquartered in Redwood City, California.
 
Dexterity is backed by world-class investors such as Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, and Obvious Ventures. We are a diverse and multidisciplinary team with a culture built on passion, trust, and dedication.
About the Role
Dexterity is seeking a hands-on senior marketer to make our story clear, credible, and commercially useful. You will create qualified enterprise demand, define our position in Physical AI, translate complex technology for enterprise buyers, and generate content that brings our systems to life.
You will serve as Dexterity's overall marketing lead. This is a Principal/ Director level position reporting to the VP, Product & Enterprise Growth, with company-wide functional ownership and no direct reports initially. You will set direction, choose priorities, and personally create and measure the work. The role has four priorities: enterprise demand; category positioning and content generation; executive voice, social, and content distribution; and events, trade media, and industry engagement. It is designed for a senior marketer who wants broad growth stage ownership and still enjoys hands-on work.  You and the VP, Product & Growth will agree on priorities and tradeoffs. 
You will work directly with executive leadership and partner closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Customer Success, etc. AI-driven workflows and automation will be core to the function, with human review wherever strategy, creative quality, technical accuracy, or confidentiality matters.
Responsibilities
Create Qualified Enterprise Demand
Partner with Sales on priority segments, target accounts, buyer needs, lead criteria, and follow-up.
Design and run focused account-based and industry campaigns that connect Dexterity's technical differentiation to real operational problems.
Build the campaign journeys, content, landing experiences, and tracking needed to improve and scale what works.
Report sourced and influenced pipeline honestly, with a documented attribution method that distinguishes engagement from qualified demand.
Build Category Positioning and Content 
Define Dexterity's positioning, value proposition, audience messaging, and competitive story across Physical AI, robotics, and warehouse automation.
Translate technical capabilities and deployment realities into clear narratives for business and technical audiences.
Maintain a core message framework used across the website, sales materials, launches, executive communications, recruiting, and events.
Personally create content across videos, demos, technical explainers, launches, web, presentations, and sales enablement.
Lead Executive Voice, Social Media, and Content Distribution
Build credible voices for Dexterity and its executives, and run the editorial calendar from drafting through publication.
Turn important product, technical, company, and market moments into channel-specific content.
Repurpose and distribute priority content across social, web, email, executive channels, and Sales.
Measure whether the work reaches and engages target buyers, partners, technical audiences, media, and talent.
Coordinate Events, Trade Media, and Industry Engagement
Enable Dexterity's presence at priority events, including MODEX, ProMat, and NVIDIA GTC, from planning through follow-up.
Coordinate schedules, collateral, executive participation, target-account meetings, and lead capture with internal teams and direct vendors.
Build relationships with relevant business, AI, robotics, logistics, supply-chain, and trade media. Develop pitches and prepare spokespeople.
Review event and media results based on account engagement, meetings, follow-up, reach, and whether key messages landed.
Use AI and Automation Across the Function
Build repeatable AI-driven workflows for research, content creation, campaigns, distribution, follow-up, and reporting.
Automate repetitive work where it improves speed or quality, and measure the results.
Document each workflow and set clear requirements for human review, source verification, confidentiality, and data handling.
How the Role is Prioritized
The expected allocation is approximately:
30%: Enterprise demand and focused campaigns
25%: Category positioning and content generation
25%: Executive voice, social, and content distribution
20%: Events, trade media, and industry engagement
The allocation is directional and will shift with business needs. 
Qualifications Required
8+ years of relevant B2B marketing experience, or comparable work demonstrating Principal-level judgment and ownership.
Experience operating with solo-marketer scope in a complex technology environment, either company-wide or for a product, category, segment, or business line. You personally owned both strategy and execution without relying on a large specialist team.
Experience marketing enterprise AI, physical AI, robotics, or complex industrial technology to enterprise operations buyers in logistics, supply chain, warehousing, fleet, manufacturing, or a related/ similar environment.
Strong writing and editorial judgment, with the ability to turn technical products into clear positioning, videos, demos, explainers, launches, sales materials, and campaigns.
Evidence of audience or demand growth you can defend with numbers, including the channel, timeframe, method, and business result.
Experience partnering with Sales on targeting, account-based programs, lead or opportunity creation, follow-up, and defensible pipeline measurement.
Regular use of AI tools in your own work, including at least one repeatable AI-driven workflow or automation with measurable results and appropriate review and data controls.
This role requires regular work from Dexterity's Redwood City headquarters and 10-20%  travel to customer sites and priority industry events.
Qualifications Preferred
Experience marketing Enterprise AI, Physical AI, or robotics products to enterprise buyers.
Relevant experience in an adjacent technical market such as industrial automation, autonomy, AI infrastructure, logistics technology, connected operations, supply-chain software, or developer tools.
Experience marketing products used in production or another operationally complex environment.
Relationships with relevant business, technology, AI, robotics, logistics, or supply-chain media and analysts.
Experience designing event programs around target accounts, executive participation, and follow-up.
Broad marketing judgment matters more than deep specialization in every discipline. You should be able to produce strong work, measure its commercial value, and focus limited resources.
Compensation
Base pay is one component of Dexterity's total rewards package, which may also include equity, comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits, and other compensation elements depending on eligibility.
The annual base salary range for this position is $180,000–$210,000 USD. 
Actual compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, skills, and overall qualifications. Final compensation will be determined on a case-by-case basis and will also consider relevant experience and internal equity.


Equal Opportunity Employer
Dexterity is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all employees and applicants are treated with fairness and respect.
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, religious creed, ancestry, national origin, citizenship, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, and related medical conditions), gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, medical condition, genetic information, physical or mental disability, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.
Dexterity is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities and to applicants requiring accommodations during the hiring process, consistent with applicable law. If you require an accommodation, please let us know.
Use of Artificial Intelligence in Hiring
Dexterity may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to assist with certain aspects of the hiring process, such as reviewing application materials, organizing candidate information, or identifying potential inconsistencies based on available information. These tools support our recruiting team but do not replace human judgment. All employment decisions are made by qualified individuals based on the overall qualifications of each candidate.
